verdict.rationale: Tavily documents some batch and async capability. Extract accepts up to 20 URLs in one request, with per-URL failures reported separately. Research runs as an async task whose status and results can be retrieved by request ID. The Python SDK also offers an async client for concurrent calls. However, nothing shows a batch or async job endpoint for search queries themselves, and rate limits cap throughput at 100/1,000 RPM. Missing for 10: batch submission for search queries, an async job queue or webhook completion for high-volume workloads, documented bulk throughput tiers beyond RPM limits, and independent hands-on corroboration.
